_comment: Grammar terms in Arabic script for the Konsep library (operator 2026-10-10: "mention the arabic word like majrur in arabic letter, not only the transliteration"). ONE table: every page shows a term from here, never retyped. `ar` is checked by terms.py / validate_terms.py against `attest`: {"pron": <term>} = the operator-approved pronunciation dictionary (authored/pronunciation.json, byte-equal), {"page": "<book>/<id>", "text": <verbatim excerpt of at most 12 words>} = a Shamela page of a kitab the Konsep library cites, pinned by the sha256 of its extracted text in sources.json `shamela_istilah` (fetch.py). The folded term must occur in the excerpt as whole tokens (proclitics allowed on the first), with no vowel conflict except on a token's last letter; with the cache, the excerpt must be a verbatim substring of the pinned page's matn ("part": "hamesh" = the editor's footnotes). A term no source verifies has ar null + `unverified` and is shown in Latin only. `forms` are the surfaces the prose writes ([[majrur]] in the authored concepts); a form left unmarked in prose fails the build, except `ambiguous_forms` (also ordinary Indonesian words: huruf, hal, sifat, bab, jumlah, syarat), which are marked only where they are the term. `hint` (harakah terms) is the short reminder shown at a term's first use on a page. Excerpts are chosen by a person (the check proves the spelling, not the sense); the spelling's harakat follow the dictionary convention, and an unvocalised excerpt confirms the letters only.
